images.purpose: PostgreSQL used by the disposable owner integration-test command.

readiness.semantic_assertion: Within 60 seconds the registered readiness phase retries SELECT current_database() in the generated Compose project and verifies POSTGRES_DB before creating the INTEGRATION_DB_NAME database guarded by the _test suffix.

configuration.isolation_strategy: The owner command generates a random cdo-integration-<16 hex digits>-<pid> project, registers cleanup before start, and passes explicit project/file arguments for every operation. Registered phase limits are enforced with Python process-group deadlines on Linux/macOS. Cleanup removes only the owned project containers, network, and volumes; failure or timeout fails the command.
